title: Electrolytic Recovery of Spent Indium Zinc Oxide Targets in Aqueous Solution
authors: Jiale Zhou, Shaolong Li, Zepeng Lv and Jianxun Song
abstract: Indium zinc oxide (IZO, typical mass ratio of indium oxide to zinc oxide is 9:1) is widely employed in advanced electronic devices. During the preparation and application of IZO, a large amount of spent IZO is generated. However, the recycling of spent IZO commonly confronts significant challenges, including high energy consumption, severe environmental pollution, and complex pretreatment requirements, which impede the sustainable utilization of strategic metal resources. To address these issues, this study proposes a green electrochemical method for recycling In and Zn from spent IZO at room …

title: Exact <mark>Electrochemical Impedance</mark> of Heterogeneous Electrodes Modeled as Coupled Finite RC Transmission Lines
authors: Anis Allagui, Mamdouh Assad, Ahmed Amine Hachicha and Enrique H. Balaguera
abstract: A porous electrode interfaced with an electrolyte does not have necessarily uniform electrical properties along its thickness. For instance, the front of the electrode may age at a different rate than that of the back, resulting in different oxidative states of the solid matrix along its thickness and thus a depth-dependent electrical conductivity. Likewise, the electric double-layer capacitance cannot be spatially uniform, given the complex pore geometry and the resulting spatial distribution of ionic species and dielectric properties.
